newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Costello sees future budget cuts.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Costello sees future budget cuts.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said he believed that further budget tightening would be needed in future years.
Asked whether the government had tightened the budget enough, Costello said: "I don't think we could sit still and say that's all that we need to do."
"I believe that we would look again at that," Costello told a post-budget business dinner in Sydney, referring to the shape of the budget from 1999.
On Tuesday the government announced a budget with an underlying deficit of A$3.9 billion for the year to June 1998, and a A$1.6 billion surplus in 1998/99.
In two budgets, Costello has now tightened Australian public finances by more than A$9 billion on a recurrent basis.
